description: Updates an existing field rule's definition / metadata. Scope fields (assetTypeId, fieldsetId, triggerField, ruleType) cannot be changed -- delete and recreate instead.

parameters.name: rule_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the field rule.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

id.description: Unique identifier of the field rule

project_id.description: Project this rule applies to; null for company-level rules

asset_type_id.description: Asset type this rule applies to. Populated for FIELD_DEFAULTS; null for NAMING.

fieldset_id.description: Fieldset scope. '-1' for Procore default fields, external configurable fieldset id for custom fields. Null for NAMING.

trigger_field.description: Field that triggers this rule (e.g. asset_code for NAMING, custom_field_1234 for FIELD_DEFAULTS)

definition.description: Structured rule definition. Shape depends on ruleType: FieldRuleDefinitionDTO for NAMING, FieldDefaultsDefinitionDTO for FIELD_DEFAULTS.

is_active.description: Whether the rule is active and applied; false to deactivate without deleting

validation_errors.description: Validation issues detected on this rule. Null when the rule is valid; a non-empty list otherwise.

items.description: Validation issue detected on a field rule at read time.

overridden.description: Project-scope overlay indicator. Populated only in the project-scoped list view: true when a project rule overrides the company configuration for this field (value and/or editability differs, or no...

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

schema.description: Request to update a field rule (definition + metadata)

rule_type.description: Optional metadata. NOT updatable: if provided, must match the existing rule's type; the server rejects mismatches.

fieldset_id.description: New fieldset id. FIELD_DEFAULTS only; ignored / rejected for NAMING. Provided to recover a rule whose asset type's fieldset has been changed by an admin. Must match the asset type's current fieldse...

definition.description: Rule definition. Shape must match the rule's stored type — for NAMING, supply expression_fields; for FIELD_DEFAULTS, supply actions. Sent as a raw JSON object; the server converts it to the correct...

is_active.description: Whether the rule is active. Set to false to deactivate.
